title: Final answer length
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the correct length of the black mark as 8 m.

title: Block acceleration correct
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the block's acceleration as a = μg = 2 m/s².

title: Belt kinematics phases
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly analyze the belt's motion in two phases: accelerated (until v0) and constant velocity.

title: Relative motion condition
description: Important Criteria: The response must identify that slipping stops when the block's velocity equals the belt's constant velocity v0.

title: Displacement difference method
description: Important Criteria: The response must calculate the mark length as the difference in displacements (belt minus block) during the slipping period.

title: Time calculations
description: Optional Criteria: The response may show correct calculations for the time the belt accelerates (2 s) and the additional time for the block to catch up (2 s).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response may demonstrate consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the relative displacement is incorrectly calculated (e.g., block displacement greater than belt's) or if acceleration directions are confused.

title: Incorrect friction force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the kinetic friction force is miscalculated (e.g., using static coefficient or wrong normal force).
